en.text:
Scoring a kill with your Melee, Sword, Glaive, Super Light Attack, or Finisher begins <strand/>'Banner of War' for 15 seconds. Banner of War has a radius of 10 meters and stacks up to 4 times.

Allies within the radius are granted the following benefits:
• 100% Increased Base Melee Damage
• 40% Increased <strand/>Bladefury Damage
• 10% Increased Sword Damage (20% for the user)
• 20 HP Healing Pulses every 2.5 seconds

//Banner of War grants all allies within the radius 100% Increased Base Melee Damage, 40% Increased <strand/>Bladefury Damage, and 20% Increased Sword Damage (10% for allies). Banner of War also releases 20 HP Healing Pulses every 2.5 seconds.

Gain an additional stack when <pve 7 /> <pvp [2] /> kills occur through any of three methods:
• You kill an enemy
• An enemy within a 20 meter radius of you dies
• An ally within a 20 meter radius of you kills an enemy
//An ally scores a kill, or an enemy dies, within a 20 meter radius of you.

Each kill extends the buff timer up to 30 seconds, with the extension dependent on the number stacks you currently have. Higher stacks reduce the delay between each healing pulse.

Extension amount and Healing Pulse delay per stack:
• x1: 6 seconds | 2.5 Seconds
• x2: 5 seconds | 2 Seconds
• x3: 4 seconds | 1.5 Seconds
• x4: 3 seconds | 1 Second
